acceptance_checks.check_id: A rerun creates a distinct Run ID; reconnect/resume retains an AgentSession ID only when continuity of the same logical session is established, otherwise a new AgentSession ID is required; Runtime ID persists across reconnect/restart only for the same enrolled trust identity.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Exact references to revisioned entities bind ID plus revision. ID-only/latest references are not accepted as durable execution, authorization, replay, or evidence authority. Provider/native identifiers are stored as foreign metadata and never substituted for Kernux IDs.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Revision is a positive uint32 semantic value 1..4294967295, starts at 1, increments exactly one for each accepted canonical mutation of a revisioned entity, uses expected-revision compare-and-swap, rejects zero/overflow/stale writes, and remains JSON-number-safe.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical identity document, ADR-0038, architecture alignment, protected PR qualification, and post-merge main CI.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The architecture decision and canonical identity document preserve provider neutrality, do not introduce donor/provider names into the core contract, and leave resource URI, event envelope, schema source, and generated type details to their declared later P01 tasks.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The contract states UUIDv7 creation time is not authorization, freshness, causal order, event order, or a substitute for an explicit timestamp/sequence; clock rollback/skew cannot confer authority.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical identity document, ADR-0038, architecture alignment, protected PR qualification, and post-merge main CI.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The identity contract enumerates exactly the nine macro-task entities and assigns each an RFC 9562 UUIDv7 canonical ID with lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 text, version 7, RFC variant, non-nil value, opaque/non-secret semantics, and no encoded provider/entity/business meaning.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical identity document, ADR-0038, architecture alignment, protected PR qualification, and post-merge main CI.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The mutability matrix explicitly covers all nine entities: Project, Task, WorkUnit, Runtime, and Artifact canonical metadata are revisioned under bounded rules; Run, AgentSession, Evidence, and Event are immutable identity records with revision fixed at 1, with new logical occurrences/assertions/facts receiving new IDs.
